# Grahko

> Grahko takes local shops and small businesses in India from offline to online. We build mobile-friendly websites and Android apps, set up the shop on Google Maps (Google Business Profile), set up WhatsApp Business (catalog, auto-replies, automatic bookings and orders), and keep helping after launch. IIT Delhi-led engineering team based in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad (Delhi NCR), working with clients across India in Hindi and English.

## Who it is for
Electricians, plumbers, grocery (kirana) shops, medical stores, salons and parlours, clinics, coaching centres, schools, dhabas and restaurants, clothes shops, lawyers and CAs, gyms, and other small businesses.

## Plans (one-time cost, no lock-in, everything in the client's name; a Google Maps listing is free in every plan)
- Website: mobile website (up to 5 sections), .in domain and hosting free for 1 year, a free Google Maps listing, call/WhatsApp/directions buttons, prices, photos and map, 15 days of free changes.
- Website + WhatsApp: the full website, Google Maps listing, WhatsApp Business setup (catalogue and auto replies), a logo and a Google review QR standee, plus 3 months of help and a monthly report.
- Everything: all of Website + WhatsApp, plus an Android app on Google Play in the client's name, automatic WhatsApp bookings/orders, UPI payments, Instagram and Facebook pages, and monthly updates, local SEO and a report; the monthly part can be stopped any month.
- Custom: website, app and software built around the client, such as school portals, billing, and CA/lawyer systems, with staff logins and training.
Current prices and offers are on https://grahko.in/#pricing

## Business promotion (monthly, 3-month minimum)
- Local Boost (₹2,999/month): weekly Google Business Profile posts and photos, a reply to every review, 8 social media posts a month, monthly report.
- Growth (₹5,999/month): Google profile upkeep, 12 posts and 4 reels a month, WhatsApp offers to 500 customers, Google or Instagram/Facebook ads managed, monthly report and call.
- Pro (₹9,999/month): Google profile upkeep, 16 posts and 6 reels a month, WhatsApp offers to 1,000 customers, Google and Instagram/Facebook ads managed, a reel shoot at the shop every month.
Ad spend is paid by the client directly to Google or Meta. Results are not guaranteed. Details: https://grahko.in/services

## Paperwork and tax (by Grahko's tax partner, a GST and sales-tax practitioner)
GST registration, GST return filing (monthly or quarterly), Udyam (MSME) registration, FSSAI food licence, income tax return (ITR) filing, and Shop & Establishment / trade licence. Government fees extra at actual. Details: https://grahko.in/services#tax

## Add-on services (on their own or with any plan)
- Get found: Google Maps listing, local SEO, Google review booster, JustDial and IndiaMART listings, Swiggy and Zomato listing help.
- Get more customers: Google Ads, Instagram and Facebook ads (ad spend paid by the client to Google/Meta), social media posts and reels, WhatsApp offer messages, Instagram and Facebook page setup.
- Look professional: logo design, shop photoshoot (Delhi NCR), promo reels, print kit (visiting card, pamphlet, QR standee), business email.
- Run the shop: WhatsApp Business setup, UPI payments, product catalogue, billing and stock software, an Android app.
Prices are on https://grahko.in/services

## How it works
1. Talk on WhatsApp, phone or video call. 2. Pay half to start, the rest when the work is done, with a receipt. 3. See the first design in 3–4 days. 4. Website live in about 7 days (apps take 15–20 days for Google Play approval).
